name: Celestial Bond
source:
"Luna is a princess from the Katharos water faction. Her parents want to get her married with a prince of the earth faction, in order to fuse both factions and get more powerful. Right before her wedding, Luna meets Maya; a criminal Amaritian. She starts feeling an intense warmth she hasn’t felt before and, soon enough, runs away from home to be with the love of her life."
